notes.title: Updated to ver1.01.
notes.content:
→ver1.01
Stick input thresholds have been adjusted. The behavior of holding onto a ladder or entering a door with a slight up/down input has been improved.
The behavior of holding onto a ladder or entering a door with a slight up/down input has been improved.
The shallow left/right input is for walking, and the large left/right input is for running.
Basically, the game uses a dash, so the game is adjusted to run if the input is normal without worrying about it.

Changed so that when jumping from a ladder, it takes a little longer to grab it again.

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Guide To Switching Languages
notes.content:
While Tobari 2: Nightmare does not have a built-in language switcher like Tobari 2: Dream Ocean does, you can still access the Japanese version of the game or the English version if you are currently playing it in Japanese.

1. Go to your Steam LIbrary and either right-click on Tobari 2: Nightmare or click the gear button on the game page and click on Properties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40842193/ddb854c100f27c7484008e0c5296f2851c7edfe2.jpg

2. Click on Language then select the language you wish to play Tobari 2: Nightmare in. After you make your selection, you will be prompted to Update the game. After that, you're good to go. Good luck and have fun!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40842193/0ee4d573800b7d32314e02af5bd5041e4d2dc70a.jpg
